Population increased in Bury

The estimated population of Bury in 2024 was 198,921 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

This meant that Bury's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Bury increased by 2.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Bury was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Bury

The average (median) age fell to 40.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Bury has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Bury is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Bury's population of 198,921 usual residents was made up of:

  • 39,550 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.9%)
  • 122,871 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.8%)
  • 36,500 people aged 65 years and over, (18.3%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Bury has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (19.9% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Bury, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Bury
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Bury, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 178 people (0.1%). In total, there were 2,049 births and 1,871 deaths in Bury.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 172 (0.1%). There were 10,286 people entering the area and 10,114 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Bury's population of 1,842 (0.9%) as a result of 2,482 people entering the area and 640 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Bury was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Bury in mid-2023 is 196,719.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 874 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 369 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,243 people.
